title: Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Zoe Marks is the Oppenheimer Faculty Director of Harvard's University-wide Center for African Studies and a Lecturer in Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School. Her research and teaching focus on the intersections of conflict, social movements, and peacebuilding; gender and intersectional inequality; and African politics.
research_interests: Politics Human Rights Fairness & Justice Gender
